parties: Navinchandra Vershibhai Haria; Aakash Exploration Services Limited
headline: Navinchandra Vershibhai Haria files SEBI Regulation 10(5) disclosure under Takeover Code
sum: Substantial shareholder Navinchandra Vershibhai Haria has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a significant share acquisition or change in shareholding pattern in Aakash Exploration Services Limited.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosures are gating triggers for open offers and acquirer liability under the Takeover Code-review whether the disclosure threshold (25% of paid-up capital or voting rights) has been crossed and whether an open offer obligation arises under Regulation 15.
detail: The disclosure was filed with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) under Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates that any person or group acquiring 25% or more of shares or voting rights in a listed company must disclose the transaction to the stock exchange and the target company within two days. The filing does not specify the acquisition value, number of shares acquired, or the post-acquisition shareholding percentage. No concurrent open offer announcement or acquirer identification details are evident from this disclosure alone.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 10(5)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement when any person acquires 25% or more of shares or voting rights in a listed company.
Triggers open offer obligation if acquisition exceeds 25% threshold without prior approval or exemption.
Defines substantial acquisition and application of Takeover Code to listed companies.
Requires disclosure of changes in shareholding above 2% threshold to the company and stock exchange.
Grants SEBI authority to regulate acquisition of shares and takeovers.

framework.ref: Listing Agreement / SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015 – Schedule III
framework.note: Defines continuous disclosure obligations for listed companies during substantial acquisitions.

conditions: Filing of Regulation 10(5) disclosure with NSE within two days of substantial acquisition
Verification of whether 25% threshold has been crossed

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
triggers.note: Regulation 10(5) disclosure filing is mandatory for acquisitions of 25% or more; triggers open offer obligation under Regulation 15 if no exemption applies.
Complementary disclosure requirement for shareholding changes above 2% within 2 days.
